item.title: References
item.description:
Every behaviour of the engine that follows an external format or protocol is written against one of the documents below. The engine repository’s own docs/REFERENCES.md says, for each, which version was opened and which file it governs.

Reference What it decides
OCI Image Format Specification (v1.1.1) digests, manifests, image indexes, image config, layers and whiteouts, image layout
OCI Distribution Specification pulling manifests and blobs from a registry
Docker Registry token authentication the bearer-token challenge and token request
Docker Engine API (v1.47) the endpoints and schemas wctrd is compatible with
Wasm OCI artifact layout (CNCF TAG-Runtime) media types and config fields of a Wasm image
wazero (v1.12.0) the runtime, its WASI preview1 imports and writable filesystem interface
WASI preview1 the system interface a wasip1 module is written against
